items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Did you ever hear Freddie Keppard?

ctx.x: I don't know, I believe he was playing then. Go walking and play with him. Buddy Petey. Oh yes, I never knew him but I knew his stepfather but I never knew Buddy. That's who he used to play with. All them old players, like the other boys, I don't know much of them. Yeah, this La Rocca used to live just across the street from Wild Estate on 3rd Street. Some boys used to brag on him good. I believe he died in California. California. And so...
Do you remember any of the other bands when you were younger? Did you ever hear Freddie Keppard? No. That you remember?
